section.intro: Pair a phone makes a single-use code that lives five minutes and asks for your password first. The MyPetKit app scans it and trusts this server only.

list.label: Client tokens
list.confirmBody: The app on that phone is signed out at once and has to be paired again.

pairing.title: Pair the iOS app
pairing.qrLabel: QR code for pairing the iOS app
pairing.paired: {{name}} is paired. The code is used up.
pairing.expired: This code has expired. Create a new one to pair a phone.
pairing.scan: Scan this code in the MyPetKit app. It carries this server’s address and certificate fingerprint, so the app trusts this server only.
pairing.compare: The app shows the same fingerprint before it connects. If they differ, do not continue.
pairing.copyFailed: Copy failed; select the code instead.
